metadata.data_source: Supplied aligned asset returns; demo asset histories are synthetic.
metadata.source: Supplied aligned asset returns; demo asset histories are synthetic.
metadata.return_convention: Buy and hold, horizon simple returns; volatility uses sample standard deviation (ddof=1); no annualization.
metadata.pressure_definition: Original bank cash first falls strictly below its operating buffer at a modeled end of day; the event is fixed across allocations.
metadata.tail_definition: 95% CVaR of signed portfolio loss at the first cash-buffer breach, conditional on a breach; exact fractional upper 5% mass, including ties. Negative loss means a gain.
metadata.cash_sleeve: Zero-yield hypothetical portfolio cash; it does not top up bank cash or change the pressure event.
metadata.evaluation_scope: Independent simulation paths from the same fitted history. Frozen discovery allocations and frontier flags; not an out-of-time backtest or a forecast-confidence interval.
metadata.frontier_scope: Nondominated among explored candidates, not the complete continuous frontier. Lower volatility and pressure tail, higher mean return are preferred.
metadata.execution_scope: Hypothetical long-only allocations without fees, taxes, settlement, or trade execution.
